title: Netskope Client Troubleshooting & Diagnostics Toolkit
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (diagnostics toolkit + runbooks for steering/auth/performance issues across the Netskope client; PowerShell/Python).
Netskope console internals are deferred to Netskope's official documentation (no fabricated menus); authored at the correct architectural/procedural level.
hook: Fix Netskope client issues fast — with a real diagnostics toolkit, not guesswork
problem: When the Netskope client misbehaves — traffic not steering, auth loops, slow browsing, an app broken behind the proxy — the help desk burns hours guessing. This solution gives your team a Netskope client troubleshooting and diagnostics toolkit: structured runbooks for the common failure classes (steering, authentication, performance, certificate/decryption) plus PowerShell/Python diagnostics that collect the right logs and state and point to the root cause.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Netskope client architecture from a support view, the common failure classes (steering, auth, performance, certificate/decryption), and the diagnose-then-resolve model.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (the Netskope client on endpoints, log access, Intune for at-scale collection, admin access for verification) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: stand up the diagnostics toolkit, build the per-failure-class runbooks, wire log/state collection, validate against known issues, then pilot with the help desk, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — client-state discovery, steering/auth/connectivity validation, a client-health and issue report, safe remediation (restart/repair/re-enroll client with -WhatIf), and a diagnostics-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A Netskope client troubleshooting and diagnostics toolkit — structured runbooks for steering, auth, performance, and certificate failures, plus PowerShell/Python diagnostics that collect the right state and point to the root cause. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A Netskope client troubleshooting and diagnostics toolkit — runbooks for steering, auth, performance, and certificate failures, plus diagnostics that collect the right state and point to root cause.
meta_description: Troubleshoot the Netskope client: runbooks for steering, auth, performance, and certificate issues, plus PowerShell/Python diagnostics and log collection. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts (Netskope specifics deferred to vendor docs).
bottom_line: Netskope client issues resolved fast — failure-class runbooks and diagnostics that collect the right state and point to root cause — so the help desk stops guessing, proven on a pilot before you scale.

hero.tagline: DIAGNOSE FAST.  FIX THE ROOT CAUSE.
